# mcp-studio

> One resource. Two runtimes. Same signal, every time.

One resource. Two runtimes. Same signal, every time.

This is an independent, art-directed explainer for ruvnet's mcp-studio — it takes a newcomer from "never seen it" to "ready to implement", grounded in a real RVF knowledge base of the source.

## What it is
mcp-studio: the patch bay — a studio signal jack where one cable is split and plugged into two monitors at once

## For your AI
A downloadable knowledge pack (RVF vector KB + MCP server) ships with this page so your agent can search the source too: https://mcp-studio-explainer.netlify.app/mcp-studio-knowledge-pack.zip

## Links
- Live explainer: https://mcp-studio-explainer.netlify.app/
